honest_limits: L-C2-1: k-axis substrate (autopoietic closure cycle on 8-site catalytic lattice) ≠ rule-axis substrate (1D elementary CA, length-16 periodic). '동등'은 Φ pattern 동등이지 substrate-mechanism 동등 X — different microdynamics may share pattern-level signature.

L-C2-2: 4-point k sweep + 3 rule classes = sparse mapping. Spearman ρ on n=3 ranks is COARSE rank-correlation (denom n³-n=24, minimum rho step 0.25). Finer k-sweep + 4+ rule-class sampling would tighten the correlation estimate but stays within the same family of rank statistics.

L-C2-3: H_007/H_204 Φ 절대값 단위 다름 — k-axis 8-site lattice transient Φ ∈ [3.5, 5.4] range while rule-axis 16-site CA Φ ∈ [0.0, 0.6] range. Only ranking-correlation is meaningful here; absolute Φ value matching is NOT claimed.

L-C2-4: Φ peak ≠ 'consciousness' — H_004 boundary carry (functional reducibility 부분, phenomenal qualia 미터치). The cross-axis mapping is about *dynamical signature* of integrated information, NOT a claim about phenomenal experience.

L-C2-5: 본 cycle 은 *correlational* observation — k 와 rule 사이 causal mechanism 부재. 둘 다 inverse-U Φ pattern 을 보이는 것이 pattern-level analogy 이지, k=0.25 closure 가 'rule-110-같은 internal computation' 을 한다는 mechanistic claim 은 만들지 않는다.

L-C2-6: rule-axis Class-II representative 누락 — C2.4 'k=0.5 ↔ Class-II periodic' 는 spec에 명시되었으나 rule-axis Φ는 3 rule (250/110/30) 만 측정. Class-II 측정은 rule 184 또는 rule 232 등 별도 cycle. 본 cycle 의 C2.4 는 k-axis 만 검사 (descending arm structure).

L-C2-7: Spearman threshold 0.7 (C2.5) 는 design choice — n=3 paired ranks 위에서 sample-size-corrected critical value 가 아니다. n=3 의 가능한 ρ 값은 {-1.0, -0.5, 0.5, 1.0} 사실상 4 levels — 본 threshold 0.7 은 '동일 ranking' (ρ=1.0) 만 PASS 로 인정하는 effective 한 보수적 cutoff.
